findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lab_animate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Animate a completed image into a clip with a video model. Pick the model from lab_list_models; check the price with get_cost or let the user confirm a card via lab_propose. Costs credits when called without get_cost." → after: "Generate a clip from text or animate a completed image with a video model. Without a start image, uses text-to-video where the model supports it (lab_list_models: t2v). Check the price with get_cost or let the user confirm a card via lab_propose. Costs credits when called without get_cost."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
